mcq_fix.s: Which one of the following groups consists of major in-migration (destination) States of India?
mcq_fix.why: stem oddly tied to 'the migration data'

mcq_drop.why: ambiguous 'leading position in the stated pattern'; obscure Census sub-table trivia
'correct order ... mentioned in the data' is ambiguous; ordering of UP/Bihar not established by notes

pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: groundnut production / agricultural crops

patterns: Theory-proponent identification: 'whose name is associated with migration theory' with demographic-transition names (Notestein, Thompson) and Doubleday as distractors.
APPSC asks migrant welfare schemes directly with a year (GKRA launched 2020 for returnee migrants); the app has no GKRA item.
UPSC-style 'how many statements correct' on the GCM: all countries / binding / internal migration traps, all false.
Stream questions turn on rural-rural being the largest (female, marriage) vs rural-urban (male, employment).
The app leans heavily on 2025-26 current figures (e-Shram, WMR 2026, Konaseema) and long statement items; PYQs are short single-fact questions.
